main.description: A publication: a named collection of articles published as a web page and as RSS/Atom feeds. Presence of this record in a repository makes the publication public.

name.description: Display name of the publication. Mutable presentation attribute.

description.description: Short plain-text description of the publication.

slug.description: URL path segment for the publication. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens; must not start or end with a hyphen. Mutable presentation attribute; uniqueness is enforced by the publishing service, not by this schema.

icon.description: Optional icon for the publication, used as the favicon of its pages and as its feed image. Square is expected. The blob is the source image, not a delivery artifact: an implementation resizes and re-encodes it for the sizes and formats its delivery needs. Omitted means the publishing implementation's own mark.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared time of the most recent update (RFC 3339).
